const fs=require('node:fs'),path=require('node:path'),assert=require('node:assert/strict'),crypto=require('node:crypto'),{chromium}=require('playwright');
const R=path.resolve(process.env.JH_BROWSER_SOURCE_ROOT||path.join(__dirname,'..')),OUT=path.resolve(process.argv[2]||'/tmp/chart-regional-fed-browser');fs.mkdirSync(OUT,{recursive:true});
const read=p=>fs.readFileSync(p),hash=b=>crypto.createHash('sha256').update(b).digest('hex'),cat=JSON.parse(read(path.join(__dirname,'../config/regional-fed-series.json'))),review=JSON.parse(read(path.join(__dirname,'../docs/audit/2026-10-04/chart-regional-fed-watchlist-review.json')));
const targets=[...Object.values(review.alternatives).map(r=>r.alternative),'regionalfed:kc-manufacturing:year-nsa:production','regionalfed:kc-manufacturing:six-month-expectation-sa:production'];
assert.ok(process.env.JH_REGIONAL_FED_HISTORY_ROOT,'Independently checked source packets required');const packets=Object.fromEntries(targets.map(id=>[id,JSON.parse(read(path.join(process.env.JH_REGIONAL_FED_HISTORY_ROOT,hash(id.toLowerCase())+'.json')))])),catalogue=read(path.join(__dirname,'fixtures/chart-provider-discovery/data/provider-catalog.json'));
const scripts=['jh-watchlist-store.js','jh-watchlist-quotes.js','jh-chart-tvrail.js','jh-observation-series.js','jh-observation-cache.js','jh-chart-cftc.js','jh-chart-catalog.js','jh-chart-engine.js','jh-chart-row-handoff.js','jh-chart-provider-browser.js'];
const html=read(path.join(R,'chart.html')).toString().replace(/<script\b[^>]*>[\s\S]*?<\/script>/gi,'').replace(/<link\b[^>]*>/gi,'').replace('</body>','<script src="/fixture-library.js"></script>'+scripts.map(s=>'<script src="/'+s+'"></script>').join('')+'</body>');
function directory(u){const dataset=u.searchParams.get('ds').split(':')[1],terms=(u.searchParams.get('q')||'').toLowerCase().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean),offset=Number(u.searchParams.get('offset')||0),limit=Number(u.searchParams.get('limit')||50),rows=Object.values(cat.series).filter(d=>d.dataset===dataset&&terms.every(t=>(d.id+' '+d.name+' '+d.provider_name).toLowerCase().includes(t))).map(d=>({id:d.id,provider:'regionalfed',kind:'series',name:d.name,chartable:true,unit:d.unit,currency:null,freq:'M',first:null,last:null,n:null,live_history_verified:false}));return {provider:'regionalfed',ds:u.searchParams.get('ds'),offset,limit,total:rows.length,rows:rows.slice(offset,offset+limit)};}
(async()=>{const browser=await chromium.launch({headless:true,executablePath:process.env.CHROMIUM_EXECUTABLE_PATH}),report=[];try{for(const width of [1440,390]){
 const context=await browser.newContext({viewport:{width,height:1000},serviceWorkers:'block',acceptDownloads:true}),page=await context.newPage(),requests=[],errors=[];let rejected=false;
 page.on('pageerror',e=>errors.push(e.message));await context.addInitScript(()=>{localStorage.setItem('jh-chart-custom-lists',JSON.stringify([{id:'regional-fed-fixture',name:'Invented list',symbols:['SPY'],custom:1}]));localStorage.setItem('jh-tv-watch-ui',JSON.stringify({active:'regional-fed-fixture'}));localStorage.setItem('jh-chart-watch-pin','0');});
 await context.route('**/*',async route=>{const u=new URL(route.request().url());requests.push(u.pathname+u.search);const send=(v,type='application/json',status=200)=>route.fulfill({status,contentType:type,body:Buffer.isBuffer(v)||typeof v==='string'?v:JSON.stringify(v)});
  if(u.pathname==='/chart.html')return send(html,'text/html');if(u.pathname==='/fixture-library.js')return send(read(path.join(R,'tests/fixtures/chart-observations/vendor/lightweight-charts-4.2.3.js.txt')),'application/javascript');
  if(scripts.includes(u.pathname.slice(1))||u.pathname==='/jh-chart-tvwatch.js')return send(read(path.join(R,u.pathname.slice(1))),'application/javascript');
  if(u.pathname==='/data/provider-catalog.json')return send(catalogue);
  if(u.pathname==='/explorer'){assert.equal(u.searchParams.get('provider'),'regionalfed');return send({provider:'regionalfed',offset:0,total:2,rows:Object.values(cat.datasets).map(d=>({id:d.id,provider:'regionalfed',kind:'dataset',name:d.name}))});}
  if(u.pathname==='/browse'){assert.ok(Object.values(cat.datasets).some(d=>d.id===u.searchParams.get('ds')));return rejected?send({},'application/json',403):send(directory(u));}
  if(u.pathname==='/series'){const id=u.searchParams.get('id'),key=targets.find(x=>x.toLowerCase()===id.toLowerCase());assert.ok(key,'Only selected exact series');return send(read(path.join(process.env.JH_REGIONAL_FED_HISTORY_ROOT,hash(key.toLowerCase())+'.json')));}
  if(u.pathname==='/data/tv-watchlists.json')return send({lists:[{id:'regional-fed-fixture',name:'Invented list',symbols:['SPY']}]});
  if(['/ohlc','/yf-ohlc'].includes(u.pathname))return send({ticker:'SPY',span:'day',mult:1,bars:[]});
  if(u.pathname.startsWith('/data/')||u.pathname.startsWith('/api/'))return send({});return route.abort('blockedbyclient');
 });
 try{
  await page.goto('https://fixture.regional-fed.test/chart.html');await page.waitForFunction(()=>window.JHChartProviderBrowser&&window.__jhTvWatch2);await page.locator('#symchip').click();await page.locator('#jh-provider-open').click();
  await page.getByRole('searchbox',{name:'Filter provider metadata'}).fill('regionalfed');await page.getByRole('button',{name:'Search',exact:true}).click();await page.waitForFunction(()=>document.querySelector('.jhp-status').textContent.startsWith('1 provider entries'));
  assert.equal(await page.locator('button.jhp-row').count(),1);assert.ok((await page.locator('.jhp-rows').innerText()).includes('no published stored-file catalogue'));
  await page.getByText('Source receipt and original metadata',{exact:true}).click();const downloadEvent=page.waitForEvent('download');await page.getByRole('button',{name:'Download original metadata',exact:true}).click();const download=await downloadEvent;assert.equal(hash(read(await download.path())),hash(catalogue));await page.screenshot({path:path.join(OUT,'discovery-'+width+'.png')});
  for(const id of targets){
   if(id!==targets[0])await page.evaluate(()=>JHChartProviderBrowser.open());

   const ds=cat.datasets[cat.series[id].dataset].id;await page.locator('.jhp-row').filter({has:page.getByText(ds,{exact:true})}).getByRole('button',{name:'Choose series / dimensions',exact:true}).click();await page.waitForFunction(()=>document.querySelector('.jhp-status').textContent.includes('Rows 1'));
   if(id===targets[3]){assert.equal(await page.getByRole('button',{name:'Next',exact:true}).isEnabled(),true);await page.getByRole('button',{name:'Next',exact:true}).click();await page.waitForFunction(()=>document.querySelector('.jhp-status').textContent.includes('Rows 51'));}
   await page.getByRole('searchbox',{name:'Filter provider metadata'}).fill(id);await page.getByRole('button',{name:'Search',exact:true}).click();await page.getByText(id,{exact:true}).waitFor();await page.locator('.jhp-row').filter({has:page.getByText(id,{exact:true})}).getByRole('button',{name:'Chart exact series',exact:true}).click();await page.waitForFunction(id=>jhWatchlistActive()===id&&window.jhChartEvidence&&jhChartEvidence.symbol===id,id);
   const packet=packets[id],points=packet.obs.filter(r=>r[1]!==null).map(r=>[Date.parse(r[0]+'T00:00:00Z')/1000,r[1]]);assert.deepEqual(await page.evaluate(()=>lastBars.map(r=>[r.time,r.close])),points);assert.equal(await page.locator('#tabs .tab.on').getAttribute('data-id'),id);assert.ok((await page.locator('#quote').innerText()).includes(packet.unit));assert.equal(await page.evaluate(()=>jhChartEvidence.observations.whole_packet.id),id);assert.equal(await page.evaluate(()=>jhChartEvidence.observations.whole_packet.calls_eligible),false);
   if(width===390){if(await page.locator('#w-close').isVisible())await page.locator('#w-close').click();await page.waitForFunction(()=>document.querySelector('#watch').classList.contains('is-collapsed'));assert.ok((await page.locator('#stage').boundingBox()).width>=350);}
   await page.screenshot({path:path.join(OUT,id.replace(/[^a-z0-9]/gi,'_')+'-'+width+'.png')});
  }
  await page.evaluate(()=>JHChartProviderBrowser.open());await page.locator('button.jhp-row').filter({hasText:'Regional Federal Reserve Banks'}).click();await page.getByText('regionalfed:chicago-cfnai',{exact:true}).waitFor();rejected=true;await page.locator('.jhp-row').filter({has:page.getByText('regionalfed:chicago-cfnai',{exact:true})}).getByRole('button',{name:'Choose series / dimensions',exact:true}).click();await page.waitForFunction(()=>document.querySelector('.jhp-status').textContent.includes('HTTP 403'));assert.equal(await page.locator('.jhp-rows').innerText(),'');assert.equal(await page.evaluate(()=>jhWatchlistActive()),targets.at(-1));
  await page.getByRole('searchbox',{name:'Filter provider metadata'}).press('Escape');assert.deepEqual(errors,[]);assert.ok(!requests.some(p=>p.startsWith('/data/providers/regionalfed')||/^\/(ohlc|yf-ohlc)\?/.test(p)&&/regionalfed/i.test(decodeURIComponent(p))));const size=await page.evaluate(()=>({scroll:document.documentElement.scrollWidth,client:document.documentElement.clientWidth}));assert.ok(size.scroll<=size.client+1);
  report.push({width,passed:true,actual_network_requests:0,all_provider_entrypoint_checked:true,whole_catalogue_export_checked:true,no_nonexistent_warehouse_key:true,all_selected_values_compared:targets,denial_not_substituted:true,mobile_chart_visibility_checked:width===390,errors,requests});
 }catch(error){fs.writeFileSync(path.join(OUT,'failure-'+width+'.json'),JSON.stringify({error:String(error),errors,requests,body:await page.locator('body').innerText()},null,2));await page.screenshot({path:path.join(OUT,'failure-'+width+'.png')});throw error;}finally{await context.close();}
 }fs.writeFileSync(path.join(OUT,'browser-qa.json'),JSON.stringify(report,null,2));console.log(JSON.stringify({passed:true,widths:[1440,390],actual_network_requests:0}));}finally{await browser.close();}})().catch(error=>{console.error(error);process.exit(1);});
